notes.title: 2025.3.7 BugFix
notes.content:
1. Fixed the the number of coins deducted might be incorrect during refresh.
2. Fixed the the character is in a walking state when entering the game for the second time.
3. Weapons cannot be combined or sold on the failure and pause screens.
4. Fixed the basic data display on the bestiary interface.
5. Weapon type icons are no longer displayed on the store interface.
6. The detailed effects of item sets will not be shown on the store interface and item selection interface.
7. Adjusted the number of monsters spawned.
8. Adjusted the skills of monster.
9. Reduced the movement speed of ranged monsters.
